calculation.description: Ranks recent five-day relative underperformance after scaling each instrument's residual by its trailing 20-day daily-return volatility. Higher values indicate volatility-adjusted short-term relative losers expected to mean-revert. The cross-sectional median is computed only from contemporaneous completed prices.

validation.regime_notes: Positive across 2020-2022, 2023-2024, and 2025-2026; ICIR was 0.1319, 0.0844, and 0.1118 respectively. Small 15-instrument universe implies uncertainty; daily admission uses dates with at least 8 valid instruments.
